name: marquee
description: KOZMOS Marquee: a status-line ticker. Model and effort, context fill, 5-hour and weekly limits with the reset countdown, session cost, git branch with ahead and dirty counts, and the tool running now, refreshed every second; it scrolls like a marquee when longer than its width. /marquee toggles it.

width.title: Width
width.description: Characters the status line may take; a longer line scrolls.

segments.title: Segments
segments.description: Which segments to show and in what order, comma-separated: model, ctx, limits, cost, git, tool.
